subject: Recap + lightweight implementation playbook & next steps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Menon <priya.menon@novascale.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 13, 2027 at 09:12 AM -0800
Subject: Recap + lightweight implementation checklist

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a tiny playbook to make the POC kickoff as painless as possible. High-level notes:

- Goal: validate latency and cost for NovaScale's anonymized document search (10–15k tokens/session).
- Success criteria: end-to-end query within 350ms P50 and < $0.02/query on typical load, plus embedding similarity recall >= 0.88 on your eval set.
- Constraints you mentioned: staging infra access delayed until the end of the month; legal flagged a short data residency confirmation.

Proposed next steps (short and concrete):
1) I attach a 1-page "POC implementation checklist" — if you can drop the staging IPs (or the cloud VPC allowlist) to me or Ben, we can pre-provision the dedicated test instance.
2) Ben will stand up a skeleton model config and a sample dataset loader once we have network access (should take ~1 business day).
3) Let's schedule a 30-minute "kickoff run" next week to watch the first end-to-end run together — I put two optional windows in the mutual action plan (attached).

Attachments: poc-implementation-checklist.pdf (1-page), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (dates/options).

If now is low-priority on your side, a quick "yes/no" reply is perfect — we can hold the items and ping back in two weeks. Otherwise, if you want, I can do a short 15-minute pre-kickoff to unblock infra people asynchronously.

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments

Quick nudge on this; just checking whether NovaScale still plans to move forward with the POC in the next few weeks. If timelines shifted, totally fine — a one-line update helps us prioritize the dedicated slot.

- Open a separate thread directly with staging/network if that speeds the allowlist.

I attached mini-playbook.pptx — it's two slides: "What we need" and "What you should expect on day 1".

- Tue Jan 26, 10:00–10:30

Thanks, Hannah and Ben — sorry for the radio silence.

Short update from my side: our infra team has been pulled onto an urgent migration and legal is still finishing a quick data residency confirmation (we expect that to wrap in ~3 weeks). Given that, we won't be able to start the staged POC this week.

That said: we do want to run this with Redwood — the success criteria you outlined make sense. Can you (a) share the mini-playbook and the checklist as a single PDF I can hand to infra/legal, and (b) record a short 10–15 minute walkthrough we can watch asynchronously? That will let us keep momentum without blocking the infra team.

If possible, let's tentatively aim for a kickoff week of Feb 15; I'll confirm once the migration and the residency check are done.

Appreciate the flexibility — and please keep the slot open for us if you can.

Best,
